title: Synthetic Training Manual: Priority Before Routine

manual_pages.title: Purpose and inputs
sections: SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.
Record whether either synthetic danger indicator A or B is present and whether a routine condition is present.
The two danger indicators are required before any routine result may be recorded.

manual_pages.title: Priority rule
sections: If either synthetic danger indicator is present, record SYNTHETIC_PRIORITY_EXIT.
SYNTHETIC_PRIORITY_EXIT takes precedence over every routine condition.
Only when both danger indicators are recorded absent may the CHW evaluate the routine condition.

manual_pages.title: Missingness rule
sections: If either required danger indicator is missing, record incomplete assessment and do not take the routine branch.
A missing indicator is unknown, not false.
Record which required input is missing for review.

must_include: do not take the routine branch
